svg.title: Fixed n-gram speculation: fewer steps, higher expert traffic

cc:Work.dc:title: Fixed n-gram speculation: fewer steps, higher expert traffic
cc:Work.dc:description: Natural EOS; 16 requests/run, n=2 independent runs/arm. Bars: run means; points: individual runs. Each metric is normalized by the AR run mean. Completion time includes final drain; initialization and warmup are excluded. Output counts differ; times are not equal-work speedups. OLMoE; artificial expert-cache cap of 24 experts/layer.
